overall_verdict: Unchanged partial static triage: AS-01/AS-04 reportable unvalidated candidates; AS-02/AS-05 suppressed; AS-03/AS-06 blocked. Ledger dispositions and finalization remain unpersisted.
confidence_basis: Conservative subjective medium assessment, not a tool-measured probability. Independent reruns support D1-D3 application to recorded booleans; synthetic observations were not source-verified and establish no exploitability confidence.
limitations: Only six synthetic candidates were assessed. No application source, runtime or test harness is supplied; dynamic_validation=false and coverage is partial.
Tools record supplied reviewer observations; rerunning them verifies decision inputs and rules, not the actual application behavior.
